title: Happy Family in Wood-Paneled Rumpus Room, 1953 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Bill converted the garage into a rumpus room. in summer of 1953.
description: A relaxed family poses together on a couch inside a home interior featuring dark vertical wood paneling, woven wicker end tables, matching table lamps, and a small coffee table. The family consists of a father reclining on the side, a mother, and three children. The back of the photo notes that 'Bill converted the garage into a rumpus room. in summer of 1953.' Rec rooms and rumpus rooms created from converted garages or basements became a staple of post-World War II American suburban family life and DIY culture in the early 1950s.
